comment: Reviewed, accepted static-triage findings for JANEF Forge's own skill content. Each entry names why the flagged text is intentional. Used only by the quality gate's self-scan; never for external candidates.

accepted.reason: Deliberate vulnerable-vs-fixed example of command injection; the fixed form follows immediately.
